name: Yoshihata Tooru
source:
Tooru is Nao's husband and Natsuhi's father. He's a lazy and selfish man who doesn't want to work.

He is always doing suspicious things to make money and he spend the money only on things for himself and not for his family. He has been scammed and now has a debt.
translation:
Tooru is Nao's husband and Natsuhi's father. He's a lazy and selfish man who doesn't want to work.

He is always doing suspicious things to make money and he spend the money only on things for himself and not for his family. He has been scammed and now has a debt.
